interaction.prompt: You're in the corner with the puck. Tap the teammate who gives your team the best chance to score.

feedback.right: The LW is open in the slot — right in front of the net where goals happen. That pass puts your team in the best position to score.
feedback.wrong: Scan the slot first when you're in the corner. The RW has a defender right beside them on the boards, and the LD has an opponent glued to them at the point. The LW is open in the high-danger slot — that's where the puck needs to go.

tip: In the offensive zone, always look to the slot before the wall or point — the closer to the net, the higher the scoring chance.
why: Decision making means choosing the highest-value option, not just the safest pass. The open slot player gives the team the best shot at scoring even if the corner-to-slot pass is harder than a chip to the wall.
